description: This file defines the TemporalExpressionPrinter class, which implements a visitor pattern for pretty-printing various TemporalExpressions in a calendar or scheduling context.

classes.name: TemporalExpressionPrinter
classes.description: A class that implements the TemporalExpressionVisitor interface to generate a pretty-printed string representation of TemporalExpressions.

methods.name: appendExpression
methods.description: Appends a given TemporalExpression to the StringBuilder with proper indentation.

methods.name: appendIndent
methods.description: Appends spaces to the StringBuilder based on the current indentation level.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Generates the string representation of the expression by accepting the visitor.
